description: This PHP class 'PartialTheme' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\CorporateBranding\Dto' serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for theme-related information in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding module. It encapsulates properties such as theme ID, name, variables, social media icons display flag, and filenames for various banners and logos, with methods to access and instantiate from a Theme object.

classes.name: PartialTheme
classes.description: DTO class representing a partial theme with properties such as ID, name, visual variables, and banner/logo filenames, with methods for creation and property access.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Returns the array of theme variables.

methods.name: showSocialMediaIcons
methods.description: Returns whether social media icons are to be shown.

methods.name: getClientLogoFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the client logo, if any.

methods.name: getClientBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the client banner, if any.

methods.name: getLoginBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the login banner, if any.

methods.name: createFromTheme
methods.description: Static factory method to create a PartialTheme instance from a Theme object.
